content: For a portfolio site with mostly static content and a few interactive islands (wallet connect, device-frame demos), Next.js App Router static generation (SSG) per-route is the standard 2026 approach: prerender all content/blog pages at build time, deploy as a static-friendly Next.js app, and isolate wallet/on-chain widgets as client components loaded dynamically (ssr:false) to avoid hydration mismatches with browser-only wallet APIs. No need for full SSR since content changes infrequently.
